description: I am a PhD Climate Scientist and Senior Meteorologist with 15+ years of experience in hydrometeorology, climate change assessment, extreme-event analysis, flood forecasting, and multi-hazard early warning systems. I am interested in collaboration with researchers, meteorological and hydrological institutions, governments, UN agencies, development organizations, and other partners working to strengthen climate resilience and climate services across Africa and globally.
